plans.title: Three-bed Family House
plans.brief: A three-bedroom single-storey house. The road is on the south, the garden on the north — I want the bedrooms and living room on the garden and bifold doors out to it.

plans.title: Courtyard Apartment
plans.brief: A ground-floor flat built around a private courtyard — one bedroom, a bathroom off the hall, and living that opens onto the court.

plans.title: Neighbourhood Clinic
plans.brief: A small neighbourhood clinic: reception and waiting, three consulting rooms, a treatment room, staff room and an accessible toilet. Wheelchair users must get everywhere.

plans.title: Compact Bedsit
plans.brief: A tiny studio flat, about 35 square metres. I want a proper wardrobe and doors that don't eat the floor.
